Name: Maria Santos (Cohort A – Disaster Victim)
Feedback: I was amazed that I didn't need to sign up or input my password. In an evacuation center fast aid without filling out 10 paper forms is life-saving.

Name: Juan dela Cruz (Cohort A – Disaster Victim)
Feedback: The 4-step wizard is very clear on my phone! Would be great to have a downloadable receipt or proof to show the local checkpoint marshals.

Name: Engr. Danilo Santos (Cohort B – MDRRMO Chief)
Feedback: Merkle tree upload from CSV makes disbursement prep instant. We need a live transparency indicator showing active contract balance.

Name: Volunteer Field Marshal (Cohort C – Civic Tech)
Feedback: Lace wallet connection was fast once installed. An interactive onboarding tour explaining zero-knowledge to non-crypto users would be helpful.

Name: Dr. Ricardo Lim (Cohort C – Security Researcher)
Feedback: Deterministic nullifier derivation ensures double claiming reverts on-chain without doxxing the citizen. Proving time under 2 seconds is impressive.

Name: Lola Remedios (Cohort A – Elderly Victim)
Feedback: Text is too small on my budget Android phone in bright sunlight at the evacuation center. Need larger fonts and higher contrast.

Name: Atty. Corazon Reyes (Cohort B – Municipal Treasurer)
Feedback: I want to see the lifecycle of each claim — when it was submitted proved and disbursed — for my own audit trail.

Name: Nanay Perla (Cohort A – Rural Evacuee)
Feedback: In rural evacuation centers elderly victims need Tagalog or Cebuano options rather than pure English technical terms.

Name: Field Coordinator Ruel (Cohort C – Volunteer)
Feedback: Cell reception drops to 2G/EDGE during typhoons. The app should save draft state offline without losing progress.

Name: Checkpoint Marshal Andrei (Cohort C – Volunteer)
Feedback: Barangay checkpoints and evacuation marshals need a 1-second way to verify a citizen's relief receipt voucher without touching their phone or seeing their private resident identity.

Name: Budget Officer Elena (Cohort B – Municipal Auditor)
Feedback: Municipal auditors wanted an interactive simulator in the Admin Dashboard to test emergency tranche top-ups and dual-officer threshold approvals before dispatching live tDUST to the Midnight contract.
